run_download_gnome_data: run the script to download GNoME data files from Google Cloud storage to a local directory
run_download_gnome_data_custom_dir: run the script with --data_dir to download GNoME data to a custom output directory
copy_blob_from_gcs: copy a blob from a Google Cloud Storage bucket to a local directory
download_license_file: download the LICENSE file from the gdm_materials_discovery GCS bucket
download_stable_materials_csv: download stable_materials_r2scan.csv and stable_materials_summary.csv from GCS
